attributes.action: ban teachers from being allowed to say "you cant go to the toilet" during lesson
attributes.background: to put in rules saying that when children need the toilet they are allowed to go to the toilet in all schools including private schools because teachers don't know it could be for a medical reason.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: 

Give students the legal right to unrestricted toilet access in school https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/760890
